message.reasoning_content: Law 1: tax 10% on future sales. I already voted yes; now it would pass anyway (yes 4 > no 1). Tax 10% hurts me for round 6 sales... I have promissory 80 alashi which converts to cash next round. My rank: cash+hard = 80 after conversion. Others have ~26 and ~2. Tax reduces my sales revenue round 6. Better to veto? Veto cancels the law; then no tax. But wait — I voted yes, but veto overrides. Veto helps my round 6 sales. But does keeping tax hurt rivals more? They sell too; I'm top seller. Veto for my own benefit.
